text: Play-based learning does not mean an absence of academics. Play is the vehicle for learning, because young children experience the world as a whole, not in separate subjects. Here is how every subject comes alive through play.

image.alt: Children playing outdoors and learning at tables in a bright, plant-filled classroom

text_2: Counting with blocks and cooking · Stories, songs and phonological games · Planting, shadows and insects · Friendships and solving conflicts · Climbing, balancing and building · Paint, clay, music and the “hundred languages” of children
